1 of 5. Priya builds a sales report that adds up each branch's sales and stamps every line with a fixed label figure, say 'Region 3'. Every branch gets the same figure, so it says nothing about the branch.
  A) The fixed figure is just printed on every line. Branch totals come out exactly as they would without it.  B) The report is refused, with a message asking her to remove the fixed figure first.  C) The report runs, but the fixed figure appears only once at the top, not on every line.
  Your answer (a letter, or your own words) >

2 of 5. A report adds a fixed Rs 50 handling charge to each order amount, then totals orders per branch. The Rs 50 is fixed, but the order amount differs for every order.
  A) The charge is treated as part of the order amount. Totals are built from the real order amounts, as they are today.  B) Totals are built per branch only, and the Rs 50 is added once per branch, not once per order.  C) The report is flagged for a person to check, because fixed and changing figures are mixed.
  Your answer (a letter, or your own words) >

4 of 5. A list of orders has a fixed figure, say 'Season 3', on every line. It has no totals. Staff sort the list, or filter it to 'Season 3 only'.
  A) Nothing changes. The figure is shown, sorted and filtered exactly as before.  B) The figure is shown, but sorting and filtering by it are switched off, since it's the same everywhere.  C) Filtering stays, but staff see a warning when they sort by a figure that never changes.
  Your answer (a letter, or your own words) >

5 of 5. Last year you saved 40 reports that total things up, some with fixed figures stamped on the lines and some without. They all run with the new fix in place.
  A) All 40 give exactly the same results and layout as before. Only reports that used to fail now work.  B) Reports that gave odd results before now give corrected ones, and your staff are told which ones changed.  C) Old reports keep running the old way. Only newly built reports get the fix.
  Your answer (a letter, or your own words) >
